+import importlib, inspect, pkgutil, json, sys

+from tinygrad.uop.ops import PatternMatcher, deconstruct_function
+

+  try:

+  except Exception:
+    continue
+  for pmname, pm in inspect.getmembers(mod, lambda o: isinstance(o, PatternMatcher)):
+    for pat, fxn in getattr(pm, "patterns", []):
+      if not callable(fxn) or id(fxn) in seen: continue
